orders.jaymoskingdoms.text.taken: From %s, already taken and paid for. It is on its way once it is made up.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.no_town: This board serves no town, so no merchants take orders here.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.refused: The merchants of %s won't sell to you.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.none: No merchant about this town has anything to sell for silver just now.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.locked: %s more wares at a higher standing.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.title: %s x%s for %s
orders.jaymoskingdoms.text: Sold by %s, %s of %s. Pay %s now; a courier brings it to you once it's made up.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.text.ordered: From %s, paid %s. Cancel before it's sent for your money back.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.objective.left: You may order this %s more times today.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.objective.sold_out: Sold out to you for today. More at dawn.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.objective.courier: Ready. Waiting on a courier to take it.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.too_many: You already have plenty waiting from this town.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.tidings.sent: Your order from the merchants of %s has gone out with %s.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.tidings.post: Your order from the merchants of %s was given to the post.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.tidings.waylaid: %s, carrying your parcel from %s, was cut down on the road near %s, %s. The goods lie there.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.want.title: Wanted: %2$s x%1$s from %3$s
orders.jaymoskingdoms.want.text: The merchants want what only %1$s gives, and pay %2$s for it.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.tidings.want: The merchants of %1$s thank you for the goods from %2$s.
